# Yunhao Luo — Personal Website

> The personal site of Yunhao Luo, an AI researcher focused on the agentic web — web agents, website generation, and emerging standards for making the web agent-friendly — with a foundation in character animation, physics-based simulation, and real-time rendering. The site is shaped like a game: an explorable, dark-fantasy HD-2D hub world ("Crepusculum Dream") where visitors use keyboard, mouse, touch, or WebMCP and each landmark leads to an area of content.

Yunhao Luo is an AI researcher at Huawei Canada's Web Technology Lab. He previously researched real-time GPU fluid simulation at Ubisoft La Forge and holds an M.Sc. in Computer Science from McGill University; his thesis work received the Best Presentation Award at MIG '21.

## WebMCP interface

This site registers WebMCP tools on `document.modelContext`. They operate the same live router and DOM used by the visitor, not a detached content API. Navigation updates the visible area, URL fragment, page metadata, and registered tools together.

`create-portfolio-tour` is the central human-agent collaboration tool. It maps a recruiting, research, technical, creative, or complete-portfolio goal to a visible route panel. The visitor and agent see the same stops; selecting one navigates the real site and focuses the relevant introduction or section.

Tool scopes:

- Global: `list-site-pages`, `get-about-me`, `goto-site-page`, `set-language`, `create-portfolio-tour`
- Home: `walk-hero-to-landmark`, `get-hero-status`
- Every content page: `get-page-overview`, `focus-page-section`, re-registered with that page's description, section enum, returned data, and visible effect
- Projects: `get-fluid-simulation`
- Research: `get-publications`, `get-citation`
- Mods: `get-mod-details`, `goto_workshop_page`
- The Zine: `read-zine-piece`
- About: `get-photography-captions`

## Areas

- [Home](/crepusculum-dream-webmcp/#/): the explorable HD-2D hub world; every landmark below lives here
- [Projects](/crepusculum-dream-webmcp/#/projects): write-up and captured demos of the real-time GPU liquid simulator built at Ubisoft Montreal using position-based fluids and GPU compute shaders
- [Research](/crepusculum-dream-webmcp/#/research): first-author publication — Catching and Throwing Control of a Physically Simulated Hand (MIG '21, Best Presentation Award), with an original summary, complete BibTeX, and publication links
- [Mods](/crepusculum-dream-webmcp/#/mods): a complete deck-building character mod (78 cards, custom mechanics, 2D animation, localization, and upstream links)
- [Zine](/crepusculum-dream-webmcp/#/zine): a modern-poetry zine, presented as readable pages
- [About](/crepusculum-dream-webmcp/#/about): bio, interests, photography, and the site's WebMCP tool documentation
